entries.name: <env:vars>
entries.why: Enumerates the whole environment so the nested firmware build inherits only an allowlisted set; build time.

entries.name: CARGO
entries.why: Path of the cargo that runs the build script, reused to build the firmware crate; set by cargo.

entries.name: CARGO_CFG_TARGET_ARCH
entries.why: Target architecture cargo passes to the build script, used to pick the UEFI triple.

entries.name: CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS
entries.why: Target OS cargo passes to the firmware build script; selects the UEFI link settings.

entries.name: CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR
entries.why: Crate directory cargo passes to build scripts and compile-time macros to locate workspace files.

entries.name: CARGO_PKG_VERSION
entries.why: Crate version cargo passes to the build script, compared with the firmware lock file.

entries.name: DISPLAY
entries.why: X11 display of the host session, read by the broker to choose the X11 view backend.

entries.name: KAYFABE_CUDART_GATE
entries.why: When set to replay, serves three GSS-legacy control ids (0x20809009/001/064) from a captured native reply; default refuses them.

entries.name: KAYFABE_C_TRACE_CAP1
entries.why: Overrides the path of the committed cold-boot capture read by the kf-crec differential oracle; default is the file under traces/.

entries.name: KAYFABE_C_TRACE_CAP1B
entries.why: Overrides the path of the second committed cold-boot capture read by the kf-crec differential oracle; default is the file under traces/.

entries.name: KAYFABE_NO_KVM
entries.why: When 1, kvm_available() reports no /dev/kvm so KVM-gated tests skip; a test and gate selector only, default off.

entries.name: KAYFABE_TRAP_CPU_SITE
entries.why: Hex BAR0 offset whose traps are sampled for wall versus thread-CPU time in the trap census; unset leaves the census unarmed.

entries.name: KAYFABE_TRAP_FATAL
entries.why: Arms the slow-trap witness with the default budget; a BAR0 trap over budget stops the process for inspection; default off.

entries.name: KAYFABE_TRAP_FATAL_ABORT
entries.why: When set, the armed slow-trap witness aborts the process on a violation instead of stopping it; default stops.

entries.name: KAYFABE_TRAP_FATAL_US
entries.why: Arms the slow-trap witness with a budget in microseconds; a BAR0 trap over budget stops the process; default off.

entries.name: KAYFABE_VCPU_BLOCK_FATAL
entries.why: When set, a blocking door reached on a vCPU thread panics the process; default only counts such hits.

entries.name: KF3_ASYNC_PREEMPT_REENABLE_NOACT
entries.why: Answers a twins-only channel re-enable with NV_OK and no host action; default off, diagnostic that was never shipped.

entries.name: KF3_BAR0_READ_TRACE
entries.why: Enables the host-side BAR0 read trace records; default off, output goes to the host log only.

entries.name: KF3_BAR0_TRACE
entries.why: Set to 1 to print bounded windows of BAR0 accesses around channel schedules to the host log; default off.

entries.name: KF3_CARRY_ATOMIC_DISABLE
entries.why: Set to 1 to carry the ATOMIC_DISABLE PTE permission bit to the walker and host map; default not carried.

entries.name: KF3_COMPLETION_PROBE
entries.why: Value in ms arms read-back of released fence semaphores and dumps of stalled Translated channels to the log; default off.

entries.name: KF3_DBFAST_PROBE
entries.why: Hex doorbell value registered on the kernel fast path for a slot no channel can occupy, to time transport only; default unset.

entries.name: KF3_DBFAST_SPIN_US
entries.why: Drainer polls doorbells up to this many microseconds (1..1000) after a delivery before parking; default off, experiment knob.

entries.name: KF3_DEBUG
entries.why: Debug-profile switch that permits KF3_DEBUG_FORCE_MIGRATABLE to take effect; unset by default, so that flag is refused.

entries.name: KF3_DEBUG_CURSOR
entries.why: Logs each distinct cursor image the host path or composer refuses, and dumps surfaces to a directory; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DEBUG_FORCE_MIGRATABLE
entries.why: With KF3_DEBUG set, routes guest user channels (GR/copy/video) through the migratable user-ring relay for validation; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DIAG_EVENT_RING
entries.why: When 1, records the last lock-step events in a ring for diagnosis; request decisions are identical either way; default off.

entries.name: KF3_DIAG_PROGRESS
entries.why: Threshold in ms above which the user-ring strand logs PROGRESS_STRAND lines; default off, log only.

entries.name: KF3_DIAG_STEP_METERS
entries.why: Set to 1 to enable per-step timing meters in the display worker counters; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DIAG_UNMAP_DELAY_MS
entries.why: Holds every unmapping VA diff for N milliseconds on the VA thread before applying it, to provoke races; default off.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_ARMED_DEFAULTS
entries.why: Set to 1 to start each core life's ARMED HEAD_SET_MIN_FRAME_IDLE mirror at 0x10002 instead of 0; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_BLANK_STATE
entries.why: Set to 1 to make a new core life report BLANK for every head's blanking control instead of 0; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_CAPS_OVERLAY_FILE
entries.why: Path to a captured display caps page read from this host GPU, laid over the derived page; unset leaves it unchanged.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_CAPS_OVERLAY_GROUPS
entries.why: Comma list of caps-page groups to overlay from the caps overlay file; empty overlays every group. Only read with the overlay file.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_CAPS_OVERLAY_WORDS
entries.why: Comma list of hex caps-page offsets to overlay from the caps overlay file in addition to the groups. Only read with the overlay file.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_CORE_AT_VBLANK
entries.why: Set to 1 to latch and notify core updates at the next active-head vblank as hardware does; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_HDCP_STATE
entries.why: Set to 1 to answer NV0073 SPECIFIC_GET_HDCP_STATE with NV_OK and zero flags instead of refusing it; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_HDMI_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to answer HDMI-related display controls (connector data, DFP info) with measured replies; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_HEAD_TIMING_EN_BASE
entries.why: Hex value that every head's head-timing interrupt-enable register reads back before the guest writes it; unset reads 0.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_HOTPLUG_EDID_SEEN
entries.why: Set to 1 to list a display in hotplugAfterEdidMask only until the guest reads its EDID; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_ILUT_CONSTRUCTOR_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to publish ILUT/TMO constructor-probe caps with an engine that refuses every display method; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_LOADV
entries.why: Set to 1 to set the head-timing LOADV status bit on every frame edge and republish event registers; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_METHOD_TRACE
entries.why: Set to 1 to log head-timing enable writes and record up to 65536 display method DMA writes; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_OLUT_CONSTRUCTOR_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to publish OLUT constructor-probe caps with an engine that refuses every display method; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_PRIVATE_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to answer private display controls 0x730122 and 0x730128 with measured reply words; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_SDR_COLOR
entries.why: Set to 1 to force the SDR colour path for any guest identity, not only the Windows profile; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_TMO_CONSTRUCTOR_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to publish TMO constructor-probe caps with an engine that refuses every display method; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_TMO_SURFACE_CONSTRUCTOR_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to publish TMO-surface constructor-probe caps with an engine that refuses every display method; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_TRACE
entries.why: Set to 1 to enable the display engine's host-side trace logging; off by default and changes no reply.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_TRACE_CAP
entries.why: Maximum trace lines per kind for the display write trace; defaults to 4096.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_WRITE_TRACE
entries.why: Set to 1 to log guest display-aperture writes, head-timing interrupts and window latches, bounded per kind; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DISPLAY_XBAR_PROBE
entries.why: Set to 1 to answer SYSTEM_GET_CAPS_V2 with measured crossbar caps and DFP_ASSIGN_SOR with a fixed topology; off by default.

entries.name: KF3_DOORBELL_CPL
entries.why: When 1, logs the guest privilege level and RIP of the first 4096 usermode doorbell writes via read-only KVM ioctls; default off.

entries.name: KF3_GSS_NATIVE
entries.why: Removed experiment: setting it to 1 only prints an ignored notice; the GSS-legacy controls stay refused. Dead read.

entries.name: KF3_INJECT_FWSEC_FAIL
entries.why: Number of FWSEC failures to inject deliberately; default 0 (none).

entries.name: KF3_INJECT_STALE_USERD
entries.why: Writes GP_PUT=GP_GET=n into the guest USERD at every Translated birth to reproduce a stale-slot flake; default off.

entries.name: KF3_INVALIDATE_CLEAR_OVER_ABSENT
entries.why: Default on: a TLB invalidate completes even when named leaves cannot be mapped; 0 restores the withheld clear for A/B comparison.

entries.name: KF3_LAZY_OBSERVE
entries.why: Set to 0 to turn off the lazy private-USERD look in the Windows USER-ring relay; default on.

entries.name: KF3_LIFECYCLE_MODE
entries.why: Selects the USER-ring lifecycle ablation (always_scan, no_pointer_markers, no_anchored_windows); default is the full lifecycle.

entries.name: KF3_MAPLOG
entries.why: When set, the memory plane logs timestamped map and unmap events to stderr; default off and invisible to the guest.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_CARVE
entries.why: Negative control: sets the firmware carve-out bound to 0, counts every vidmem leaf and forces refusal off; default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_HEAP
entries.why: Positive control that counts every birth as a USERD outside the usable heap; counter only, never refuses; default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_NO_BAR1_DOORBELL
entries.why: Skips BAR1 usermode-view classification on Hopper-and-later families so BAR1 doorbells become silent stores; default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_NO_MICRO_RESERVE
entries.why: Set to 1 to disable micro memory reservations for batched maps, refusing over-bound rows; default reservations on.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_SKIP_CAP_BRACKET
entries.why: When 1, channel-alloc calls keep CAP_SYS_ADMIN so every privileged-stamped birth must be refused, proving the reply check fires; default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_STALE_BIND
entries.why: Positive control: perturbs every recorded T-mode resolution so the stale-bind counter must move; counter only, default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_TSPACE_OVERSIZE
entries.why: Makes the T-space ring-region bound check fail so every Translated birth is refused; destructive, default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_TWIN
entries.why: Answers every passthrough birth as a guest-kernel space, refusing it by name; destructive control, default off.

entries.name: KF3_NEGCTL_TWIN_WINDOW
entries.why: Gives every new twin and prewarmed spare a store window to reintroduce the no-window defect; default off.

entries.name: KF3_NO_BATCHED_MAP
entries.why: Set to any value to turn off batched host maps and use the per-run path; default batched maps on.

entries.name: KF3_NO_GUEST_VA_RESERVE
entries.why: When set, host VA spaces skip reserving the guest VA ranges, which changes where host RM places mappings; default reserves.

entries.name: KF3_PROF
entries.why: Set to 1 or on to arm attribution and timing counters (two clock reads per trap); default off.

entries.name: KF3_PT_NSI_MIN_INTERVAL_US
entries.why: Paces non-stall interrupt edges per guest vector with a minimum interval in microseconds, clamped to 1 s; default 0 (off).

entries.name: KF3_PT_NSI_RELAY
entries.why: Set to 0 to count host FIFO_EVENT_MTHD edges without raising them to the guest; default on.

entries.name: KF3_PT_STALL_SNAPSHOT
entries.why: Set to 1 to log a USERD, ring and semaphore snapshot read from guest memory when twins stall; default off.

entries.name: KF3_PT_STALL_SNAPSHOT_MS
entries.why: Silence in ms (200..10000, default 1000) before the stall snapshot fires; only used when KF3_PT_STALL_SNAPSHOT=1.

entries.name: KF3_PUT_CACHE
entries.why: Set to 0 to turn off the guest GP_PUT cache in the Windows USER-ring relay; default on.

entries.name: KF3_READ_TRACE_MAX_BYTES
entries.why: Caps the bytes the BAR0 trace may emit; trace controls only, default bounded limit.

entries.name: KF3_READ_TRACE_MAX_RECORDS
entries.why: Caps the number of BAR0 trace records emitted; host log only, default bounded limit.

entries.name: KF3_READ_TRACE_RANGES
entries.why: Restricts the BAR0 read trace to listed register ranges; host log only, default unrestricted.

entries.name: KF3_RELAY_GET_REFRESH
entries.why: Set to 1 to also write a relayed twin's engine GP_GET into the guest slot on every host wake; default off.

entries.name: KF3_RELAY_PB_PEEK
entries.why: Set to 1 or after-fifo-update to sample and log push-buffer words after forwarding; default off, never gates work.

entries.name: KF3_RPC_BODY_TRACE
entries.why: When 1, traces bodies of posted GSP RPC records to stderr up to a fixed record and byte cap; default off.

entries.name: KF3_RPC_TRACE
entries.why: Set to 1 to log each RM command the chain answers, bounded by a process-lifetime quota; off by default, changes no reply.

entries.name: KF3_SW_SUBCH_INERT
entries.why: Set to 1 to silently accept SET_OBJECT of unknown classes on software subchannels 5-7 of T-mode rings; default off.

entries.name: KF3_TCENSUS
entries.why: Set to a non-0 value to count what every Translated channel fetches and log one TCENSUS line at free; default off.

entries.name: KF3_TRACE_NAME
entries.why: Names the device in BAR0 trace records (1..MAX characters of [0-9A-Za-z:._-]); host log only.

entries.name: KF3_TSHADOW
entries.why: Legacy alias that turns on the Translated-channel fetch census only; default off.

entries.name: KF3_USERD_RELAY_OFF
entries.why: Set to 1 to birth Windows user-work twins over the guest's own sysmem USERD without relay; default relay on.

entries.name: KF3_USER_RING_TRACE
entries.why: Directory in which refused USER-ring scans write bounded reports of GP and segment words; default off, never changes decisions.

entries.name: KF3_VRAM_ATTRS
entries.why: Selects the display VRAM allocation attribute set (s0, s1, s2); default s1, the NVKMS offscreen block-linear set.

entries.name: KF3_WALK_REFUSAL_DUMP
entries.why: When set and not 0, dumps page-table descriptors around refused walk leaves for diagnosis; default off.

entries.name: KF3_WIN_HIDE_UNTABLED_VIDEO
entries.why: Set to 1 to withhold video engines that have no derived method table from the guest, read once at realize; default off.

entries.name: KF3_WIN_REFUSE_PT_FIFO_UPDATE
entries.why: Set to 1 to refuse FIFO update controls on Passthrough channels carrying user work; default off.

entries.name: KF3_WIN_USER_RING_RELAY
entries.why: Set to 0 to disable the Windows USER-ring relay route and use the old route as a falsifier; default on.

entries.name: KF3_WIN_USER_RING_SHADOW
entries.why: Set to 1 to enable the Windows USER-ring shadow route (which also forces the relay on); default off.

entries.name: KF3_WORKER_PARK_INFINITE
entries.why: When 1, the channel worker parks with no timeout, disabling the periodic wake safety net so missed wakeups show up; default off.

entries.name: KF3_WRITE_TRACE_RANGES
entries.why: Restricts the BAR0 write trace to listed register ranges; host log only, default unrestricted.

entries.name: KF_GATE3_CE_CLASS
entries.why: Hex copy-engine class the kf-gate3 bare-metal gate uses instead of the host default; standalone gate binary, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_GATE3_GRAPHICS
entries.why: When 1, kf-gate3 adds a graphics-engine oracle arm; standalone gate binary, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_GATE_GPU
entries.why: DRM minor of the host GPU the kf-harness gates open; default 0; standalone gates, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_GOP_IMAGE_NESTED_BUILD
entries.why: Set by the inner firmware build so kf-gop-image emits an empty image instead of recursing; build environment only.

entries.name: KF_GOP_IMAGE_TARGET
entries.why: Compile-time name of the UEFI target triple the embedded GOP driver was built for, set by build.rs, not by users.

entries.name: KF_IOCTL_TRACE
entries.why: Arms the ioctl trace (ring, on, 1 or verbose) and dumps it on a hang; default off and costs one relaxed load.

entries.name: KF_LIFECYCLE_MUTANT
entries.why: Selects a deliberate lifecycle bug for the mutation check; read only when the lifecycle-mutants feature is compiled in.

entries.name: KF_NVENC_CONTEXT_INDEX
entries.why: Selects the NVENC instance (0..3) probed by the kf-nvdec-context binary; standalone probe, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_OFA_CONTEXT_INDEX
entries.why: Selects the OFA instance probed by the kf-nvdec-context binary; standalone probe, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_PHYS_ENGINE
entries.why: Selects the copy-engine instance (COPY0+N) exercised by kf-phys-oracle; default 0; standalone oracle, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_ALLOW_ADMIN
entries.why: When 1, kf-ctl-probe runs even with CAP_SYS_ADMIN and labels results admin; default refuses; standalone probe binary.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_EXTRA_ONLY
entries.why: When 1, kf-ctl-probe skips its built-in control rows and sends only extra rows; standalone probe binary.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_GSS_ROWS
entries.why: When 1, kf-ctl-probe asks the host RM every GSS replay row and prints status and changed-byte counts; standalone probe.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_HEAD
entries.why: Number of reply bytes (max 64, default 16) kf-ctl-probe prints per control; standalone probe, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_I_KNOW
entries.why: Must be 1 for kf-ctl-probe to send zeroed controls to the real host GPU; standalone probe, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_SCAN
entries.why: Control and size range list; kf-ctl-probe sends zero requests of each size to find accepted paramsSize; standalone probe.

entries.name: KF_PROBE_ZBC
entries.why: When 1, kf-ctl-probe reads the host GPU ZBC clear table read-only; standalone probe, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_REV
entries.why: Source revision string the raw client stamps into its stress output; standalone client, never serves a guest.

entries.name: KF_SELF_DEADLINE_MS
entries.why: Milliseconds after which a watchdog thread dumps the ioctl trace and aborts the process; used by the raw client, default off.

entries.name: KF_VAS_CENSUS
entries.why: When set, prints per-walk-entry run census and mirror-retire lines to stderr; log only, default off.

entries.name: KF_WALK_SERIAL
entries.why: When set, the walk kernel runs as one serial launch instead of the parallel runner, changing the walk execution path; default parallel.

entries.name: LISTEN_FDS
entries.why: systemd socket-activation descriptor count; the broker adopts the passed listening socket.

entries.name: LISTEN_PID
entries.why: systemd socket-activation pid, checked against the broker pid before the descriptors are adopted.

entries.name: OUT_DIR
entries.why: Build output directory cargo passes to the build script and to the embedding macro.

entries.name: RUSTC
entries.why: Compiler cargo passes to the build script, asked for its sysroot to check the UEFI target is installed.

entries.name: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN
entries.why: Toolchain name rustup sets; named in the missing-target message and kept for the nested build.

entries.name: SUDO_UID
entries.why: Invoking user id under sudo, used by the broker to hand its socket to that user.

entries.name: WAYLAND_DISPLAY
entries.why: Wayland socket of the host session, read by the broker to choose the Wayland view backend.
